Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class DealLifecycle

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.DealLifecycle
public final class DealLifecycle extends Object
Single source of truth for request, deal and listing status transitions, so the buyer, seller and admin portals all agree on what is allowed.

Every transition validates first and changes nothing when it fails: invalid input (a non-positive price, a bad borrow period, the wrong listing type) throws IllegalArgumentException; an illegal move for the current state throws IllegalStateException.

A listing carries at most one active deal. Accepting a request reserves the listing (or marks it lent) and declines the other open requests on it. A giveaway claim is recorded as pending and reserves the listing at once, so only the first claim succeeds while the seller accepts or declines it (SRS UC-1.4 S3, UC-2.5).
